text:
alex: quick proposal — want to route large rerank calls (>500 candidates) to a cost-optimized path automatically, based on real-time telemetry. idea: two routing buckets: `fast-dedicated` (low-latency, higher $/candidate) and `bulk-batch` (higher latency, much lower $/candidate).

priya: curious — how do we classify "large"? static threshold or dynamic? :thinking_face:

alex: start with static 500 thresh but make it configurable per-tenant. long-term: use percentile-based (e.g., route if tenant's 95th pct candidates > 400 over last 1h).

sam: need to consider scoring format. some consumers expect full float scores; bulk path might use `float16` or quantized scoring leading to slightly different ranks. are we normalizing scores today?

emily: for console UX — we should surface expected latency bands and estimated bill impact before toggling. a little "preview run" on the tenant page could show estimated p50/p95 and cost delta.

kyle: API compatibility note — do NOT change output envelope shape. if quantized model changes score range, we should add `score_normalization: "minmax|z"` hint in telemetry metadata, but keep `score` field numeric. clients shouldn't have to parse new keys for basic ranking.

alex: agreed. proposal: bulk path returns the same JSON shape, but we include optional header `X-Rerank-Variant: bulk-quant` and telemetry tag `routing.variant=bulk-quant`. clients can ignore the header.

priya: how about quotas and billing units? current unit = "candidate-score". If bulk path uses approximate scoring we still charge the same? ops wants cheaper price for bulk to reflect lower resource usage.

alex: billing proposal: keep logical units as `candidate-score`, but apply a per-variant multiplier. e.g., `fast-dedicated` = 1.0 unit/candidate, `bulk-batch` = 0.4 unit/candidate. this is transparent in usage logs.

sam: telemetry change required: we must tag each scored candidate with `variant` and record `score_diff_estimate` when we fallback/hedge so we can measure quality delta. we can compute delta by comparing top-k overlap against a small sample of live fast runs.

emily: console: add a "quality regression" chart per tenant that shows top-5 overlap and mean reciprocal rank delta over time. default hide it behind an opt-in to avoid noise.

kyle: one more API thing — what about `max_candidates` param? we already cap at 2k. if a request asks for 5000, should we reject or truncate? ops: reject with 4xx and include `retry-after`?

ops-bot: deploy bot: canary rollout of `bulk-route` started at 2024-11-02T17:42:00Z.

alex: I'd prefer server-side truncation + warning header `X-Rerank-Truncated: true` for best-effort UX, but only if `allow_truncate=true` header present. otherwise return 413 with clear message.

priya: sounds fair. also need to update client SDKs to expose `routingHints` in request builder. e.g.,

```
{
  "candidates": [...],
  "max_candidates": 2000,
  "routing_hints": {"prefer_low_cost": true}
}
```

sam: we'll add telemetry counters: `rerank.requests.routed.bulk`, `.dedicated`, plus histograms for `candidate_count`, `latency_ms` and `topk_overlap`.

emily: UI nav: add a toggle on the tenant page: "Enable bulk routing for large requests" with an explainer tooltip and sample-run button. show estimated monthly cost saving if we enable.

kyle: concerns: some tenants use exact score calibration for downstream thresholds. we should provide a "pin to dedicated" flag for critical routes. also document the score normalization behavior.

alex: yep — add `pin_to_variant: "fast-dedicated"` at route-level config and honor it in routing logic. admin-only.

priya: ops questions — what about retries/fallbacks? if bulk path fails mid-flight, we should fallback to dedicated only for top-N candidates (e.g., recompute top-50) to avoid huge cost. 

ops-bot: incident bot: previous bulk batch outage on 2024-09-10 caused delayed responses for 2h, impacted routed tenants ~3%. Postmortem linked: https://redwood.internal/incident/2024-09-bulk-batch

alex: plan: 1) implement routing tags + variant multipliers in billing & telemetry, 2) console preview & toggle, 3) SDK routingHints + pin flag, 4) score-delta sampling job to validate quality, 5) rollout with canary and ops guardrails.

sam: I'll draft the proto changes for telemetry (lightweight): add `routing.variant` and `score_source` string to each scored item. keep everything backward compatible.

emily: I'll mock console mockups Monday, will include the quality chart and the cost estimator widget.

kyle: I'll write a short doc for product describing the guarantees: latency SLOs for both variants and what "approximate" means.

priya: timeline?

alex: 2 weeks for telemetry + SDK + quick console preview, then 4-week canary. ops will run a slow ramp.

priya: noted. tagging @kyle @sam @emily to sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:

sam: +1

alex: thanks all — filing a follow-up RFC in docs repo with details and proto drafts.
